# Find connected components of 0s using BFS
import os, re
d = os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t = open(d + '/../../sessions/' + os.path.basename(d) + '.jsonl').read().replace('\\n', '\n')

G = {}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n', t):
    k, h, w = m[1], int(m[2]), int(m[3])
    grid_text = t[m.end():].split('\n')[0:h]
    rows = [r.split() for r in grid_text]
    if k not in G and all(len(r) == w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k] = [[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

demo_in = G['Demo pair 1 input']
h, w = len(demo_in), len(demo_in[0])

def find_components(grid):
    visited = set()
    components = []
    
    def dfs(i, j):
        stack = [(i, j)]
        comp = [(i, j)]
        while stack:
            ci, cj = stack.pop()
            for di, dj in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]:
                ni, nj = ci + di, cj + dj
                if 0 <= ni < h and 0 <= nj < w and grid[ni][nj] == 0 and (ni, nj) not in visited:
                    visited.add((ni, nj))
                    stack.append((ni, nj))
                    comp.append((ni, nj))
        return comp
    
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if demo_in[i][j] == 0 and (i, j) not in visited:
                visited.add((i, j))
                comp = dfs(i, j)
                components.append(comp)
    
    return components

components = find_components(demo_in)
print(f"Found {len(components)} connected components of 0s")
for idx, comp in enumerate(components):
    print(f"\nComponent {idx}: size={len(comp)}, positions={comp}")
    # Check if any cell became 8
    changed = [p for p in comp if demo_out[p[0]][p[1]] == 8]
    stayed = [p for p in comp if demo_out[p[0]][p[1]] == 0]
    print(f"  Changed to 8: {changed}")
    print(f"  Stayed 0: {stayed}")
